purpose: Regeneration recipe for every synthetic / back-translation-derived dataset used (or trialled) in this system. Scripts are in-repo; seed corpora are MANIFESTed; hashes below identify the exact artifacts produced.
note: Shipped-lineage artifacts only: the primary system's training data (0/1 uniform scheme, authentic-only training retrieval; inference retrieves k=3 fuzzy exemplars from the full authentic+BT pool). Superseded 0/3-era and failed-lever entries were pruned with the repo's primary-only slimming (2026-08-21); see git history.

artifacts.name: MT fuzzy training rows (v5 mix) -- CORRECTED 2026-08-17
artifacts.generator: training/generators/composition.py + training/generators/build_training_set.py (June/Phase-1b full-size compfz build; working-repo src/data/composition.py + src/data/build_training_set.py)
artifacts.settings: REAL-ONLY parallel data (no BT rows); 0/1 uniform prompt scheme: seeded 50% carrier mask (seed 42), carriers get ONE top-1 fuzzy exemplar retrieved from the real-only pool, rest zero-shot
